Nessuna misura della residenza. Il progr: No measurement of residence. The programme does not observe how many stablecoins euro area residents hold. It estimates a range (redefined on 2026-11-25, prompt 5): EUR 8.9 - 23.1 billion, centre 15.4, derived from the ECB consumer survey with stated assumptions. It is a survey-based estimate, not a measurement, and the two other routes attempted did not confirm it. It produces no country estimates: rule R3 allocates a total, it does not measure national holdings.
Nessun effetto causale stimato dal progr: No causal effect estimated by the programme. Module 5 does not estimate the effect of stablecoins on credit and rates: it applies coefficients published in ECB Working Paper 3199, estimated on individual banks, to national aggregates. They are orders of magnitude.
Nessun \"early warning\" validato. La re: No validated early warning. The flagging rule of module 2 marks unusual values of the index. It is not a leading signal of outflows unless the pre-registered test shows predictive content; the test result is reported either way.
Nessuna previsione dell'adozione futura:: No forecast of future adoption: the scenarios are assumptions.
La classifica del modulo 3 ordina i paes: The module 3 ranking orders countries by funding structure. It is neither a probability that deposits leave nor a judgement on the soundness of banks.
Il modulo 6 usa dati pubblici per banca,: Module 6 uses public bank-level data, not confidential supervisory data. The ordering of banks describes their funding structure: it is neither a judgement on the soundness of any bank nor a forecast of outflows.
Nessuna copertura di OTC, P2P, finanza d: No coverage of OTC, P2P, decentralised finance or networks other than those stated in each report.
